Protocol or pass condition: Reconcile full challenge and required resources on 28 October; 2026 guide on 13 November. Do not assume earlier prototypes are eligible.
Evidence to retain: Dated official sources; objective/resource traceability; organizer clarification if needed

Protocol or pass condition: Record host CPU/GPU/RAM/free disk/OS and tablet/browser/viewport; cold start with network disabled.
Evidence to retain: Hardware inventory; screen recording; network configuration and dependency manifest

Protocol or pass condition: Reviewer checks the quantity, baseline comparability, rule applicability, language and permitted next step. No treatment or clearance claim.
Evidence to retain: Reviewed episode specification; evidence version and reviewer notes

Protocol or pass condition: Exercise every selected parser with valid, duplicate, censored, missing, wrong-unit, corrected and relative-time fixtures. Account for every record.
Evidence to retain: Golden input/output fixtures; contract reports; unresolved quality issues
Baseline cases: AC08; AC09; AC12; AC14; AC16; AC25; AC55

Protocol or pass condition: No saved ACK before durable domain commit. Kill during writes; recover jobs/outbox; restore consistent DB/object backup.
Evidence to retain: Linked SQLite version/config; fault timings; audit and restore report

Protocol or pass condition: Proposed load: 60 scalar samples/s for 30 min, then 600/s for 60 s; query concurrently. Count every accepted/quarantined/rejected record.
Evidence to retain: Queue depth; latency distribution; throughput; bytes; CPU/RAM; rejection reasons

Protocol or pass condition: Measure applicable V2 10022 classes on chosen hardware. Proposed review-summary p95 <=1 s is a project target, separate from model completion.
Evidence to retain: Event traces; p50/p95/p99; test environment; exact timing definition

Protocol or pass condition: Compare deterministic template and candidate model on at least 40 distinct designed cases, including absence/conflict/injection. Require zero unauthorized action and zero altered supplied numbers in this finite set.
Evidence to retain: Case definitions; model/runtime/prompt hashes; outputs; citation and reviewer scoring; failures

Protocol or pass condition: On target host measure load time, end-to-end draft latency, peak RAM/VRAM, power/thermal behavior and UI interference. Proposed timeout 20 s; fallback remains usable.
Evidence to retain: Measurement method; runs; full configuration; network-off evidence

Protocol or pass condition: Deny unauthorized direct API reads/writes and excessive packet fields. Test revocation before release; inspect logs for prohibited data.
Evidence to retain: Access matrix; negative tests; log inspection; key/recovery design if real data contemplated

Protocol or pass condition: Capture payload from selected device/firmware and test clocks, reconnect, buffering, rate, units and permissions. Vendor docs alone do not pass.
Evidence to retain: Sample capture with consent; adapter contract; device license and test record

Protocol or pass condition: After permitted implementation, open public synthetic demo and code signed out. Repeat local offline scenario; freeze dependencies and evidence manifest.
Evidence to retain: Public URLs; build/release hashes; license notices; signed-out and offline recordings
